common_delta: From the accepted C03 two-crew formation, seed direct system failures at 2,000,000 failures per million operating hours and add a D01-shaped primary system repair at BASE-01. Its C09-DIRP task lasts 0.5 hour and requires one special P-MECH. Add BASE-02 while retaining the C03 mission and crew configuration.

variants.local: P-MECH allocated at BASE-01; no remote-support route.
variants.remote: P-MECH allocated only at BASE-02; ResourceRemoteSupport permits BASE-01 to borrow it with TFRS=0.25, TTRS=0.5 and TTRSS=0.125 hour; TaskResource.ENRMS=Y.
variants.remote-disabled: Same remote allocation and route as remote, but TaskResource.ENRMS=N disables remote support for C09-DIRP.

predeclared_acceptance: All three frozen inputs import and export without losing or altering any authored populated table row.
At least one first-replication primary system repair is visible so a local/remote/disabled comparison is meaningful.

Native event or report evidence distinguishes the remote arm's borrowing and return from the local control and ENRMS=N arm; otherwise publish only a verifiable limitation, not a behavioral success claim.
Run source hashes, native steps, GUI continuity and raw outputs are sealed and independently reviewed.
limits: A fixed seed and one native replication do not estimate failure or borrowing frequencies.
The task is direct primary system repair; mission-resource, replacement and secondary-maintenance remote support are outside scope.
No general cost, performance, cross-engine parity or GUI visual claim is inferred.
